name: Admiral Command Rail
purpose: Define authoritative service-state precedence and the Admiral governance seam for Standard vs Paid Fleet capabilities.

authority_contract.owner: may view and request eligible paid upgrades
authority_contract.captain: may operationalize an already valid entitlement when delegated
authority_contract.admiral: defines Standard vs Paid policy and grants entitlement
authority_contract.browser: never grants entitlement from local UI state

security: No service-role or secret credential is present in browser code. Server-side entitlement writes remain protected.
expansion: The same state model is reusable across all Fleet vessels.
